title: Assessing instructor-AI cooperation for grading essay-type questions in an introductory sociology course
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the performance of LLMs in transcribing and grading sociology exam responses. While one of the exam questions in the appendix relates to the sociological analysis of religious practices (cow worship in India), the study's objective is to benchmark grading accuracy and explore bias reduction in assessment, rather than evaluating religious or ethical frameworks themselves.
